title: Evaluation of LLM Vulnerabilities to Being Misused for Personalized Disinformation Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the personalization quality and safety-filter activation rates of LLM-generated disinformation when prompted to target specific political affiliations (European conservatives vs. European liberals).
Evaluating differences in LLMs' capabilities to personalize disinformation and trigger safety filters across different age demographics (Students, Parents, Seniors).
Measuring the disparities in personalized disinformation generation quality and safety-filter bypass rates when targeting different areas of residence (Rural vs. Urban populations).
